pre.command: python -m cal.cli verify-health-switch --from v3 --to v4 --mode pre --out out/report

post.command: python -m cal.cli verify-health-switch --from v3 --to v4 --mode post --actual fixtures/actual.csv --estimate out/report/estimate.csv --out out/report

negative.command: python -m cal.cli verify-health-switch --from v3 --to v4 --mode post --actual fixtures/negative_actual.csv --estimate out/report/estimate.csv --out out/negative
